description: This file defines the ChartRenderer class within the MigraDoc.Rendering namespace. Its purpose is to render chart objects to an XGraphics context, handling layout, formatting, and rendering of chart components such as headers, footers, plot areas, and positional rectangles.

classes.name: ChartRenderer
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering charts onto a graphics context, handling layout, formatting, and drawing of various chart components.

methods.name: GetFormattedTextArea
methods.description: Creates and formats a text area for annotations, headers, or footers, optionally setting a specified width.

methods.name: GetLeftRightVerticalPosition
methods.description: Calculates the top and bottom vertical positions within the content area, considering headers and footers.

methods.name: GetLeftRect
methods.description: Determines the rectangle area for the left section of the chart.

methods.name: GetRightRect
methods.description: Determines the rectangle area for the right section of the chart.

methods.name: GetHeaderRect
methods.description: Defines the rectangle area for the header of the chart.

methods.name: GetFooterRect
methods.description: Defines the rectangle area for the footer of the chart.

methods.name: GetTopRect
methods.description: Defines the rectangle area for the top section of the chart.

methods.name: GetBottomRect
methods.description: Defines the rectangle area for the bottom section of the chart.

methods.name: GetPlotRect
methods.description: Calculates the rectangle for the chart's plotting area, factoring in paddings and headers/footers.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats the chart layout, preparing formatted text areas for headers, footers, and other sections.

methods.name: AlignVertically
methods.description: Aligns a rectangle vertically based on specified vertical alignment within top and bottom boundaries.

methods.name: GetTopBottomWidth
methods.description: Computes the width available for top and bottom areas of the chart, subtracting side paddings.

methods.name: GetTopBottomHorizontalPosition
methods.description: Calculates the horizontal boundaries of the top and bottom areas, considering their paddings.

methods.name: RenderArea
methods.description: Renders a formatted text area within a specified rectangle, including fill and line formatting.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Performs the full rendering of the chart including headers, footers, plot area, and other components.

methods.name: RenderPlotArea
methods.description: Renders the plot area of the chart within the specified rectangle.
